import json,sys,math,hashlib

root=Path.cwd(); b=root/'analyses/mea_parameter_bundle'; sys.path[:0]=[str(b/'scripts'),str(root/'src')]
import fit_observations as fo, fit_campaign as c

_,rows=fo.stage6_rows(spec,mapping); weights=c.stage6_weights(spec,[r for r,_ in rows],1.)
